body:
To confirm build success.  You need a workaround until #5115 merged.
Modify a line at ports/itk/portfile.cmake.
from 
```
        -DITK_USE_SYSTEM_DOUBLECONVERSION=ON
```
to
```
        -DITK_USE_SYSTEM_DOUBLECONVERSION=OFF
```

I checked following cases.
```
vcpkg install itk:x86-windows
vcpkg install itk:x64-windows
vcpkg install itk[vtk]:x86-windows
vcpkg install itk[vtk]:x64-windows
```
continue to check -static cases also.

issue.title: [itk] Fixes broken dependencies between ITK and VTK

repository.name: vcpkg
repository.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

issue.body:
restore a line of ed9357a overrided by aa560f1
fixes #5614

body:
I checked  *-static 
```
vcpkg install itk:x86-windows-static
vcpkg install itk:x64-windows-static
vcpkg install itk[vtk]:x86-windows-static
vcpkg install itk[vtk]:x64-windows-static
```
OK.
Building non-static library still fails, is it related to this?

This got closed automatically when merging #5615.

That PR only solves the `itk` package always depending on `vtk`, even when the `ITKVtkGlue` feature is disabled; which is also the matter of this issue.

There's no regression caused by the PR, so the dynamic build failing is a separate subject.

If there's interest for non-static build, then a new issue should be opened.

I built static library with `.\vcpkg.exe install itk:x86-windows-static --recurse` and `.\vcpkg.exe install itk:x64-windows-static`, I got this error:
